brief: The canvas displays a magnified cross-section of fossilized bone and mineral layers. The scene is dominated by rigid, yet interconnected structures: distinct sedimentary layers and the metallic components of interlocking gears and cams. The gears move continuously, demonstrating the complex process by which these strata are intersected and carved into specific geometric forms, revealing the underlying mechanics of the ancient fossil structure.
